follow_up_questions.question: Have you ever had swelling of your face, lips, tongue, or breathing problems after a previous insect sting (even if you were not told it was anaphylaxis)?
follow_up_questions.reasoning: Previous systemic reactions to insect stings (even if not labeled 'anaphylaxis' or treated with an EpiPen) predict higher risk of severe reactions on re-exposure. This helps assess need for emergency preparedness and referral for immunology/allergy testing.
